## Validation

- [ ] Black formatting check passes for changed Python files (`black --check`).
- [ ] Ruff lint passes (`ruff check`).
- [ ] Python syntax compilation passes (`python -m compileall`).
- [ ] Production docstring check passes.
- [ ] Generated contracts are current (`scripts/generate_contracts.py --check`).
- [ ] Python tests pass (`pytest -q`).
- [ ] Frontend tests and production build pass where applicable.
- [ ] Docker Compose configuration validates where applicable.
- [ ] Browser / AG-UI / provider acceptance is attached or explicitly marked not applicable / not run.

## Security and synthetic-data boundaries

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private keys or credentials are committed.
- [ ] No real customer, account, transaction or contact data is included.
- [ ] Authorization, confirmation, SCA and execution boundaries are not bypassed.
- [ ] New sample data is explicitly synthetic.
- [ ] Logs, screenshots and fixtures are redacted and safe to publish.

## Documentation and presentation

- [ ] Public documentation updated where behavior or configuration changed.
- [ ] Internal-only release notes and runbooks remain outside the public source package.
- [ ] Screenshots / UI evidence added where useful (synthetic data only).
